entities.name: Ash
entities.description: Human peasant woman from Embereth, Eldraine, a refugee who disguised herself as a knight to attend the Grand Ball.

entities.name: Goddric
entities.description: Handsome partygoer at Delverhaugh who is secretly a dragon.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: Realm Ash fled after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Ash became a refugee.

entities.name: Armory Mice
entities.description: Mice who helped Ash acquire armor.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Raiders who attacked the Grand Ball.

entities.name: Cinderella
entities.description: Folktale heroine on whom Ash is based.

events.summary: Ash, a refugee adopted by Delverhaugh blacksmiths, acquires armor with mice and sneaks into the Grand Ball disguised as a knight.
events.quote: she acquired armor and disguised herself as a knight

events.summary: Goddric asks Ash to dance and she falls in love.
events.quote: she was greeted by the handsome Goddric

events.summary: When redcaps raid the party, Ash defends Goddric, who reveals his true form as a dragon.
events.quote: he revealed his true form as a dragon

events.summary: At midnight Ash flees, dropping her helmet.
events.quote: At the stroke of midnight, she had to flee the party, dropping her helmet in the escape.

relations.note: She fell in love with him at the ball.
She fought them to defend Goddric.
